stem: How does the organizational pattern of the article help develop the thesis?

options.label: A
options.text: It explains problems that could result from the inability to communicate with horses and provides possible solutions.

options.label: B
options.text: It classifies the results of research studies to support the idea that horses understand body language much like humans do.

options.label: C
options.text: It orders the events chronologically to show how horses have developed an understanding of human facial expressions.

options.label: D
options.text: It compares and contrasts the way horses communicate and make facial expressions with how other intelligent animals do.
